# Capability reference

Every operation Mnemos exposes, and how each transport provides it. A cell is either the operations that implement the capability or the reason the transport does not. **GAP** marks an omission that is not a decision: an operation that should exist on that transport and does not yet.

| Transport | Surface |
|---|---|
| go | the embedded library, `mnemos.Memory` |
| rest | `mnemos serve` |
| grpc | `mnemos.v1.MnemosService` |
| mcp | `mnemos mcp` (stdio and `--http`) |
| mcp-lite | the root `mcp` package, a core subset |
| http-lite | the root `http` package, a core subset |
| client | `go.klarlabs.de/mnemos/client` |

74 capabilities, 84 acknowledged gaps.

## Capabilities

### ingest.text

Extract beliefs from free text (ingest → extract → relate → persist) (write).

| Transport | Binding |
|---|---|
| go | `Remember` |
| rest | `POST /v1/process` |
| grpc | **GAP** — no ingest RPC; gRPC clients append pre-extracted beliefs |
| mcp | `process_text` |
| mcp-lite | `remember` |
| http-lite | `POST /v1/remember` |
| client | `Process` |

> REST and MCP run the pipeline directly; Go and the lite adapters go through Memory.Remember.
